content.title: Busboys (2026) ⭐ 5.2 | Comedy
content.text: Videos1Featured reviewsI for one really like this movie.I'd never heard of this movie and just happened to see it on Fandango and saw it the day it premiered here in Riverside california. I've seen the first few reviews and all I can say is whomever wrote those really don't like comedy. The humor was at the most quite lowbrow. That I liked. It was an entertaining storyline and I I I smiled throughout however there were a couple of scenes in it where I laughed out loud! If you didn't like this movie you're in a horrible mood. It had a great ending. Also, Charlotte McKinney is outstanding! A dream come true. If you want to see an entertaining flick and you're not in a crappy mood I suggest go and check this one out, just don't take your mom with you cuz some of the jokes will make her blush.As expectedI found it very interesting to see comedians making movies out of pocket. I think it was fun to view this as more of a student film project making it to theaters! Im routing for the team and I'm sure the films will get better if they continue to make more. This may open up a huge flood gate of indie film makers to enter this experimental arena of show business. It was nice to see well known entertainers (actors) be a part of this movie, and that was the most fun to watch for me personally.Saw it with friends and laughed!This film filled the void of the edgy non pc comedies a lot of us miss. It wasn't perfect and the budget looked smallish but I laughed with my buds and felt like it was almost 2005 again.The film was reminiscent of the happy Madison days. I'd say If you miss films like the OG happy Gilmore, grandmas boy and Billy Madison then this is for you.It's a raunchy old style comedyWhat do people expect going in this movie? It has a 90s feel, comedy, decent acting. I'm pretty sure it did what it was supposed to do. Expect a movie that is all over the place that is trying to make you laugh and you will enjoy it. It's a good movie because of the jokes and who's in it. Don't expect John wick, expect almost a National Lapoon type.Worse than I anticipated.Wasn't expecting Joe Dirt, which I love but, DAMN. Editing was bad, sound was worse (especially the music), jokes were lazy. It felt like NONE of the dialogue with written, just improvised...POORLY. Both of these guys are funnier than this EVERY DAY. Should/could have been better. I am a fan of David and Theo, was really let down.More like thisRelated interestsA pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved.
